item.title: The Coffee Lawsuit That Wasn't What People Thought
item.description: In 1992, 79-year-old Stella Liebeck suffered severe burns after spilling McDonald’s coffee in a parked car. She initially sought $20,000 for her medical costs, but the case went to trial after McDonald’s offered $800, leading to a widely misunderstood jury verdict.

item.title: Kristal Reisinger Vanished And Investigators Suspect Foul Play
item.description: Kristal Reisinger disappeared from Crestone, Colorado, in July 2016, leaving behind her phone, medication, and personal belongings. Authorities announced in 2018 that they suspected foul play, and a targeted search using human-remains detection dogs was conducted in 2025. Nearly a decade later, Kristal has never been found and no one has been charged.
